player_0.content: New plan: I failed to sort the list of words alphabetically because I didn't consider the correct order of words that start with the same letter. In the last attempt, I sorted the list as if the words were in a random order, but I should have paid closer attention to the correct alphabetical order. Next time, I will make sure to sort the list by comparing each word with the previous one, and if they start with the same letter, I will compare the second letter, and so on. For example, if I have the words "arson" and "aspect", I will compare them by looking at the second letter "r" and "s", and since "r" comes before "s", "arson" should come before "aspect" in the sorted list.
